summary: Tested independent clock toggle switches on Live Stats Entry page. All features working correctly.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Clock toggles feature fully implemented and tested. localStorage key for user auth is 'mlbl_current_user'. Admin login required to see Score button on events.

clock_toggles_in_header.details: Clock and Shot toggles appear in sticky header next to game title with data-testid attributes

game_clock_toggle_off.details: When OFF: scoreboard shows '--:--', Start/Pause/Next Quarter/Edit Time buttons hidden, only Save visible

game_clock_toggle_on.details: When ON: clock shows time normally, all controls visible (Start, Next Quarter, Edit Time, Save)

shot_clock_toggle_off.details: When OFF: center shot clock panel hidden, replaced with 'VS' divider

shot_clock_toggle_on.details: When ON: shot clock panel shows with reset button and Stop-on-Goal checkbox

independent_toggles.details: Both toggles can be toggled independently without affecting each other

compact_layout.details: Layout uses smaller buttons, tighter spacing, paddingTop reduced to 260px

data_testid_attributes.details: All data-testid attributes present: game-clock-toggle-btn, shot-clock-toggle-btn, shot-clock-panel, timer-toggle-btn, next-period-btn, home-shot-btn, away-shot-btn

screenshots_taken: .screenshots/50_toggles_both_on.png - Initial state with both toggles ON
.screenshots/51_game_clock_off.png - Game clock OFF, timer buttons hidden
.screenshots/52_shot_clock_off.png - Shot clock OFF, VS divider shown
